title: helianthemum variabile subvar. eriocaulon
intro: Helianthemum variabile subvar. eriocaulon, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species known for its pink or white flowers and drought-resistant properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include calming effects, which may help to alleviate anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
